verses.1: And David said, “This is the house of Jehovah, the God of Israel. This is the place where the sacrifices are offered for Israel.”
verses.2: And David said to his people, “Let us go and take the foreigners who are in the land of Israel. Let us dig wells from the rocks, so that we can build the house of God.”
verses.3: And from iron, they made many doors for the gates and windows. David and Nebuchadnezzar also made many such items. There was no one who could measure them.
verses.4: And there were countless cedars brought by the craftsmen and workers. David had a great number of cedars.
verses.5: And David said, “My son Solomon is a young and gentle man. Let us build this house for the Lord, so that it may be used to glorify Him and to honor His name throughout all the earth. Please help me with this task.” And David worked hard to complete this project before his death.
verses.6: And he called for Shlomo, his son, and commanded him to build an altar for the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.7: And David said to Solomon, “My son, I have always wanted to build a house for the Lord, my God.”
verses.8: And the LORD said to me, “You have shed too much blood. You have fought many great battles. Therefore, you will not build a house for me on this land, because you have shed too much blood before it.
verses.9: Now, a son has been born to you. He will be a man of peace and tranquility. I will set him free from all his enemies around him. His name will be Solomon; he will bring peace and tranquility to Israel during his reign.
verses.10: He will build a house for my name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. I will prepare him to rule over Israel forever.
verses.11: Now, my son, may Jehovah be with you. May you succeed and build the house of Jehovah your God as He has commanded you.
verses.12: But the LORD will give you wisdom and understanding, and He will command you to take care of Israel and to preserve the laws of the LORD your God.
verses.13: Then you will be successful if you keep doing what God commanded Moses to do for Israel. Be strong and not afraid, and do not yield.
verses.14: And behold, in my efforts to prepare for the house of God, I used gold worth two hundred thousand pieces, and silver worth another two hundred thousand pieces. I also used turquoise and brass—there was no limit to their quantity. I also used trees and stones in my preparations.
verses.15: And with you are many workers who cut wood and carve out wood and trees. And all wise men do all kinds of work.
verses.16: For gold, silver, and copper, there’s no end to what can be created and done. May the LORD be with you always.
verses.17: David commanded all the Israelites to help Solomon.
verses.18: Do not let Jehovah your God leave you alone, and do not allow anyone to harm you from all around. For He has given me the control over the inhabitants of the earth. The earth will be subdued before Jehovah and before His people.
verses.19: Now, let your hearts and souls be prepared to serve the LORD your God. Let us also build the holy place of the LORD God, so that we may bring the Ark of the Covenant of the LORD and all the sacred things related to God into the house that is being built for the LORD.
